detail.title: MS Office Shortcuts Extended Desk Pad
detail.overview: The Ant Esports Microsoft Office Shortcuts Mouse Pad is an extended desk mat printed with the most-used Excel, Word and PowerPoint keyboard shortcuts, turning idle desk space into a handy quick-reference sheet for everyday office work. Its large, extended size comfortably fits a keyboard and mouse together, cutting down on desk clutter while speeding up repetitive tasks for students, professionals and remote workers alike. A non-slip rubber base keeps the mat anchored during fast typing and mouse movement, while stitched edges resist fraying and keep the surface looking sharp through daily use. A practical, productivity-focused addition to any home or office desk.
